text: Lựa chọn: lật đổ nhà họ Ngụy,
style: Speak natural standard Northern Vietnamese (Hanoi) as a native Vietnamese voice actor dubbing a Chinese costume drama; no foreign accent, clear tones, natural rhythm. A low, even, emotionless synthesized electronic voice, like an airport announcement or a system prompt, word by word, now and then Line direction (written in Chinese; never read it aloud, speak only the Vietnamese line): 平板電子音，快，說完就停
